seniors.seated_version: Perform limb movements while seated in a circle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform with support from a chair or partner.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms extended toward the center, shaking motions
movement_profile.footwork: Stepping in and out of the circle

signature_moves.description: Shaking the specified body part three times.
signature_moves.name: The Shake

music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, upbeat novelty song featuring clear vocal instructions for body movements, typically accompanied by a simple, march-like or swing-influenced instrumental backing.

basic_steps: Extend the named body part into the circle.
Withdraw the body part from the circle.
Turn around in a full circle.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly; requires no prior dance experience.
